goal: Search for member M1001, open their record, open a new Savings sub-account for them with nickname "Emergency Fund" and an initial deposit of 250, then confirm and complete opening the account.

decision.thought: Start by filling in the search input with member ID M1001.

action.locatorDescription: Search input field for member ID or name
action.riskRationale: Filling a search field has no side effects.

locatorDescription: Search input field for member ID or name

decision.thought: The search input already has M1001 filled in from previous step. Now I need to click the Search button to search for the member.

action.riskRationale: Searching for a member is a read-only action with no side effects.

decision.thought: Need to open member record by clicking "View" link for M1001.

action.riskRationale: Navigating to view a member record is a read-only action.

checkpoint.description: Member detail page shows the member ID

decision.thought: On member M1001's record page. Need to click "Open Sub-Account" to start the new sub-account flow.

action.riskRationale: Navigating to a form page, no data changes yet.

checkpoint.description: Form for opening a sub-account is shown with a nickname field

decision.thought: The account type is already set to Savings by default. Next, fill in the nickname field with "Emergency Fund".

action.riskRationale: Filling a text field has no side effects until form submission.

decision.thought: Nickname is filled. Account type is already Savings (default). Next, fill the initial deposit field with 250.

action.riskRationale: Filling a form field has no side effect until submitted.

decision.thought: Account type is already Savings, nickname and deposit are filled correctly. Next step is to click Review to proceed to the confirmation step.

action.riskRationale: Clicking Review just navigates to a confirmation/review screen, no irreversible change yet.

checkpoint.description: Review page shows the nickname entered

decision.thought: The confirmation page shows all correct details: Member M1001 (Alice Nguyen), Type savings, Nickname Emergency Fund, Initial deposit $250.00. This matches the goal. Now I need to click "Confirm and Open Account" to complete the action. This is risky since it's irreversible and creates the sub-account.

action.riskRationale: This submits the form and irreversibly opens a new sub-account for the member, as stated on the page.

checkpoint.description: Success message indicating the sub-account was opened

decision.thought: The page shows "Sub-Account Opened" confirmation with account details, indicating the goal has been achieved successfully.
decision.terminalMessage: Successfully opened a new Savings sub-account for member M1001 with nickname "Emergency Fund" and an initial deposit of $250.00.
